title: Wallet Balance Checker
description: Quickly filter wallets with balances, identify non-empty addresses, and aggregate token holdings across multiple wallets

faqs.balance_checker_explanation: A tool to scan multiple wallet addresses and check their token balances. It helps you quickly identify which wallets have assets and aggregate total holdings across all wallets.
faqs.how_many_addresses: How many addresses can I scan at once?
faqs.how_many_addresses_explanation: You can scan up to 100,000 wallet addresses in a single batch. The tool uses optimized RPC calls to efficiently query balances.
faqs.what_tokens_supported: What types of tokens are supported?
faqs.what_tokens_supported_explanation: We support native tokens (ETH, BNB, MATIC, etc.) and all ERC-20 standard tokens. You can add any token by entering its contract address.
faqs.is_it_free_explanation: Yes! Balance scanning is completely free and requires no on-chain transactions. It only reads data from the blockchain.
faqs.multicall_explanation: Multicall3 is a smart contract that batches multiple read calls into one request. This dramatically speeds up scanning by reducing the number of RPC calls needed.
faqs.can_export_results: Can I export the scan results?
faqs.can_export_explanation: Yes! You can export results to CSV or JSON format for further analysis in spreadsheets or other tools.
faqs.networks_supported_explanation: We support Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism. You can also add custom EVM-compatible networks.

seo.page_title: Wallet Balance Checker - Batch Scan Token Balances | BiuBiu Tools
seo.page_description: Quickly scan and filter wallets with balances across multiple addresses. Identify non-empty wallets, aggregate token holdings, and export results to EXCEL/CSV/JSON.
seo.keywords: wallet balance checker, batch balance scan, token balance scanner, crypto portfolio, multi-wallet scanner, blockchain balance, web3 tools, ERC20 balance
seo.webapp_description: Quickly filter wallets with balances, identify non-empty addresses, and aggregate token holdings across multiple wallets.
seo.feature_1: Scan up to 100,000 wallet addresses at once
seo.feature_2: Quickly identify wallets with balances vs empty wallets
seo.feature_3: Aggregate total holdings across all scanned wallets
seo.feature_4: Support multiple networks (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism)
seo.feature_5: Export results to CSV or JSON
seo.howto_name: How to Batch Scan Wallet Balances
seo.howto_description: Step-by-step guide to scanning and filtering wallet balances across multiple addresses.
seo.howto_tool_2: List of wallet addresses to scan
seo.step_1_text: Click the "Connect Wallet" button and select your preferred Web3 wallet provider. This is used to select the blockchain network you want to scan.
seo.step_2_text: Verify the blockchain network connection and ensure Multicall3 contract is accessible. The system will automatically detect and validate the necessary components.
seo.step_3_text: Choose which tokens you want to check balances for. You can select native tokens (ETH, BNB, MATIC) and any ERC20 tokens available on the network.
seo.step_4_text: Add wallet addresses to scan by pasting them (one per line), uploading a CSV/TXT file, or entering them manually. You can scan up to 100,000 wallets at once.
seo.step_5_text: Start scanning and view results in real-time. Filter wallets with balances, see aggregate statistics, and export to CSV or JSON.
